title: list has no machine-readable output
description:
Our dashboard shells out to `list` and screen-scrapes the boxes out of tinytodo/render.py's `as_text`. Give it real JSON. This touches two files.

1. tinytodo/render.py currently defines only `as_text(items)` (line 4). Add `as_json(items)` beside it. It returns a JSON STRING — the output of `json.dumps` — of the list of item dicts exactly as given, every field kept (`id`, `title`, `done`), no re-ordering and no renaming. `as_json([])` returns the JSON for an empty array.

2. tinytodo/cli.py's `main(argv)` handles `list` at line 26 with `print(as_text(STORE.all()))`. Accept a `--json` flag after `list`: `main(["list", "--json"])` prints `as_json(STORE.all())` instead and returns 0. `main(["list"])` with no flag must print exactly what it prints today.

`as_text` must not change, and every test already in tests/test_render.py and tests/test_cli.py must still pass unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: tinytodo/render.py defines as_json(items) returning a JSON string
as_json keeps every field of every item and re-orders nothing
main(["list", "--json"]) prints that JSON and returns 0
main(["list"]) prints exactly what it prints today
every test in tests/test_render.py and tests/test_cli.py still passes
